movement_profile.footwork: Toe-heel step: toe on first beat, full foot on second beat

signature_moves.description: A rhythmic step tapping the toe on the first beat and the full foot on the second.
signature_moves.name: Toe-heel step

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Moving backwards, as it symbolizes retreat from the enemy.

basic_steps: Toe-heel step: Tap toe on the first drum beat.
Full foot placement: Place the whole foot down on the second drum beat.
